verdict.rationale: Blaxel ships an official CLI. It has a documented CLI reference, accepts API keys for authentication, and has an official GitHub Action for running it in CI pipelines. The pack only shows that the CLI exists and how it fits into workflows, not what it can do or how well. Missing for 10: details of CLI commands and capabilities, evidence of AI-native or agent-oriented CLI features, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: API keys can be used in the Blaxel APIs, CLI and SDK.
The easiest way to integrate the Blaxel CLI into a CI pipeline is with the official Blaxel GitHub Action.
